name: KOR-Bench
intro: KOR-Bench 用知识正交任务评估模型在分布外环境中读取新规则并完成推理的能力。基准以人工构建为主，覆盖运算、逻辑、密码、谜题和反事实五类任务；每类包含 25 条规则、每条规则 10 题，总计 125 条规则和 1,250 题，并通过人工检查与大模型难度/区分度检查反复修订。
org: Multimodal Art Projection Research Community and collaborating institutions
build_method: 人工规则设计, 人工与程序化问答生成, 人机质检
metric: 总体与分类别精确准确率, 反事实真实生活答案率（越低越好）, 可选组合分析通过率
task_type: 规则驱动推理, 多格式问答
eval_feature: 知识正交, Chat 分类别零样本, Base 每规则三个通用样例, 规则专用解析
build_method_en: Manual Rule Design, Human and Programmatic QA Generation, Human-LLM Validation
eval_feature_en: Knowledge-orthogonal, Category Zero-shot for Chat Models, Three Generic Examples per Rule for Base Models, Rule-specific Parsing
intro_en: KOR-Bench evaluates whether models can read novel rules and reason in out-of-distribution, knowledge-orthogonal settings. Primarily manually constructed, it covers Operation, Logic, Cipher, Puzzle, and Counterfactual tasks. Each category has 25 rules and ten questions per rule, totaling 125 rules and 1,250 questions, with repeated human review and LLM difficulty/discrimination checks.
metric_en: Overall and Per-category Exact Accuracy, Counterfactual Real-life-answer Rate (lower is better), Optional Compositional Pass Rate

drawio_review_note: Aligned with the ICLR 2025 final paper (OpenReview SVRRQ8goQo), arXiv:2410.06526v3, and official repository snapshot bb8194dff8e51e2e2247cf62aa9932c3d57d53d7. The core artifact contains five categories with 25 rules and 250 questions each: 125 rules and 1,250 questions total, ten questions per rule. Rules are manually sourced and redesigned by changing symbols, concepts, constraints, execution steps, and story contexts; Counterfactual questions are manually created and Cipher questions are programmatically generated. Human review and LLM difficulty/discrimination checks form an iterative repair loop. For evaluation, chat models use category-specific zero-shot prompts, while base models receive the same prompts plus three generic Q&A examples per rule. Official parsing falls back from double brackets to boxed output and then single brackets, followed by format- and rule-specific normalization including SymPy and LaTeX handling. Core reporting is overall and per-category exact accuracy, with Counterfactual real-life-answer rate reported separately and lower being better. Multi-Q, Multi-R, and Multi-RQ are optional compositional analyses with accuracy and all-subproblem pass rate; they are not mixed into the core 1,250-question score. The public Git snapshot provides the benchmark data and evaluation code, and an official leaderboard is available.
drawio_evidence_note: Primary evidence: ICLR 2025 final paper on OpenReview SVRRQ8goQo; arXiv:2410.06526v3; official Git revision bb8194dff8e51e2e2247cf62aa9932c3d57d53d7.
drawio_artifact_boundary_note: The 125-rule, 1,250-question release and its official parser are the core benchmark. Multi-Q, Multi-R, and Multi-RQ are paper analyses and must remain an optional side branch rather than an additional core metric.
